features.name: Redesigned 1099 App
features.description: Complete redesign of the 1099 reporting functionality moving from the old setup to a new integrated app with multi-year support, document-based reporting, and electronic filing capabilities.
caveats: IRS platform direct connection coming in next few minors, not in initial release

features.name: Multi-Year IRS Setup
features.description: New IRS setup configuration allows users to maintain different setups for different reporting periods and years, eliminating the need to wait for Microsoft updates and allowing parallel reporting for multiple years.

features.name: 1099 Forms with Document Headers and Lines
features.description: 1099 forms now include document header and line structure, making it easier to review calculated 1099 data, identify missing documents, and adjust information before reporting.

features.name: 1099 Forms History and Retention Policy
features.description: Users can now maintain historical records of 1099 forms from previous years and configure retention policies to manage database space by removing forms older than a specified period.

features.name: Electronic Filing through IRS Platform
features.description: Direct electronic filing to IRS through the IRS e-file platform via APIs, automating the complete submission process instead of requiring manual file preparation and reporting.
features.status_evidence_quote: irs through iris uh portal will come in next few minors uh now i cannot promise exactly uh date
caveats: Coming in next few minor releases, timeline depends on IRS confirmation
Requires credentials configuration for IRS platform

features.name: PDF Copy Substitution for 1099 Forms
features.description: 1099 forms can now be generated as PDF copy substitutions on plain paper instead of requiring pre-printed IRS forms, with customizable layout setup allowing users to add fields and configure which data populates each box.
caveats: Requires direct reporting to IRS through APIs
Layout customization available but requires manual configuration

features.name: 1099 Layout Customization
features.description: New 1099 layout setup page allows users to add new boxes, configure descriptions, and specify which data values populate each box on the form, providing faster support and easier updates without waiting for Microsoft changes.
caveats: Microsoft provides pre-configured reports but users can customize
Customization may be required for form layout adjustments

features.name: Automated Email Distribution to Vendors
features.description: Once 1099 forms are generated, the system can automatically send PDF copies via email to vendors who have consented to receive documents electronically, with background processing for large volumes.
caveats: Requires vendor consent to receive documents electronically
Alternative manual printing and mailing still available for vendors who opt out

features.name: Manual 1099 Form Printing
features.description: For vendors who do not consent to electronic delivery, the system can still generate and print 1099 forms on plain paper for manual distribution through standard mailing processes.

features.name: Data Transfer from Legacy 1099 App
features.description: Feature management allows users to migrate existing 1099 data from the old Business Central app to the new reporting app by selecting the active year, with data transferred to new IRS reporting periods and codes structure.
caveats: Data transfer is not one-to-one mapping

features.name: Default Data Setup for New Customers
features.description: New customers can choose to create a fresh setup with default data provided for the next year without transferring existing data.

features.name: IRS Reporting Periods with Configurable Dates
features.description: Setup of multiple IRS reporting periods with starting and ending dates, with ability to mark one as the active period for reporting purposes.

features.name: Form Box Configuration with Minimum Amounts
features.description: Configuration of 1099 form boxes with specific minimum reportable amounts and different situations for each form type.

features.name: Vendor-Specific IRS Setup
features.description: IRS setup per vendor allowing configuration of different 1099 codes and eligibility for different form codes across multiple reporting periods.
caveats: Not configured on vendor card directly

features.name: Single-Form-Type Document Constraint
features.description: Each 1099 document is for one form type only, and cannot mix different form types like miscellaneous and nonemployee compensation in the same document.

features.name: Document Status Workflow
features.description: 1099 documents have configurable status workflow starting with open status, with some statuses applied automatically and others manually.

features.name: Plain Paper Substitution Forms
features.description: Users no longer need to order preprinted forms from IRS; instead they print copy B and copy C on plain paper as substitutions with all original form details and instructions.

features.name: Configurable IRS Responsible Person Email
features.description: Option to configure a specific email address for sending 1099 documents to vendors, allowing different commercial email instead of standard vendor email.

features.name: Tax Identification Number Security Masking
features.description: Setup option to hide full tax identification numbers on printed forms and emails, showing only the last four digits for security compliance.

features.name: Flexible Form Statement Setup
features.description: Customizable form statement setup allowing configuration of print value type, filter expressions, and totaling for different printing form layouts.

features.name: Editable Form Instructions Setup
features.description: Setup page for configuring printing instructions for form headers and individual boxes, with instructions appearing on the actual printed forms.

features.name: Adjustments Per Reporting Period
features.description: Setup of vendor adjustments specific to each reporting period, allowing configuration of adjustment amounts for specific vendor and form code combinations.

features.name: Copy Setup from Prior Period
features.description: Action to copy all forms, form boxes, vendor configurations, adjustments and statement lines from a prior reporting period to a new one, avoiding manual recreation.

features.name: Vendor Form Box Suggest Action
features.description: Automated suggestion action to bulk-add vendors to form box setup based on configurable filter criteria like partner type and vendor type.

features.name: Propagate Vendor Setup to Ledger Entries
features.description: Action to propagate vendor form box and IRS code assignments to existing vendor ledger entries retroactively, without needing to manually update entries.

features.name: Vendor Card Form Box Fields
features.description: New fields added to vendor card showing miscellaneous code lookup to vendor form box setup, receiving 1099 eform consent toggle, and email for IRS field for sending PDF forms.

features.name: Form Document Creation from Purchase Invoices
features.description: New experience where form documents are created from purchase invoices with pre-populated form number and form box number from vendor setup, allowing users to see calculated values before submission.

features.name: Replace Option for Form Documents
features.description: Allows users to recreate existing form documents after modifying vendor ledger entries or posting additional documents, replacing the previously created form document.

features.name: Form Document Line Details and Ledger Entry Lookup
features.description: Users can view calculated amounts on form document lines and look up the list of connected vendor ledger entries, providing transparency on how amounts were calculated from source documents.

features.name: Including 1099 Field on Form Document Lines
features.description: Field on form document lines that indicates whether an amount will be included in the 1099 report based on comparison with minimum reportable amount, providing clear visibility to users.

features.name: Mark Submitted Action
features.description: Temporary solution allowing users to mark form documents as submitted to enable printing and mailing, before the electronic submission feature is implemented.

features.name: Print Form Document with Copy Types
features.description: Printing functionality allowing users to generate form documents in different copy types (Copy B, Copy C, Copy 2) with appropriate labels, vendor and company information, and recipient instructions.

features.name: Edit Instructions Text for Form Documents
features.description: Flexible setup page allowing customization of recipient instructions that appear on the last page of printed 1099 forms.

features.name: Email 1099 Forms to Vendors
features.description: Allows sending PDF form documents to vendors via email with consent validation, vendor email address usage, and tracking of sent copies with email status toggles.
caveats: Requires vendor consent and email address on file

features.name: Configurable Email Subject and Body for 1099 Forms
features.description: IRS form setup page allows customization of email subject line and rich control text for email body when sending 1099 form documents to vendors.

features.name: IRS Setup Naming Convention
features.description: The team designed IRS setup pages to include '1099' only on forms exclusively for 1099 reporting, while keeping generic 'IRS setup' or 'IRS form setup' names for other purposes to allow future extensibility if additional IRS-related functionality is added.
caveats: Not planning additional IRS functionality immediately; naming strategy is for future extensibility only

features.name: Future Extensibility of IRS Form Setup
features.description: IRS form setup page is designed to support potential future IRS reporting types without requiring separate setup pages, using naming convention of IRS setup without 1099 suffix.
features.status_evidence_quote: we were thinking uh maybe in the future we will introduce more IRS uh things now this is not promising do not understand me
caveats: Not a commitment; design consideration only

features.name: 1099 Feature Development from Customer Ideas
features.description: The 1099 reporting functionality delivered in this release was developed based on customer feedback and ideas submitted through the idea submission process.
